metadata.name: Little Big Adventure 2 Classic Community
metadata.summary: Modern community source port of Little Big Adventure 2 (Twinsen's Odyssey)

content.value: Little Big Adventure 2 Classic Community is an open-source modernization and source port of the classic 1997 adventure game Little Big Adventure 2 (Twinsen's Odyssey). Rebuilt using C++ and SDL3, it preserves original game behavior while bringing native 64-bit support, modernized graphics, and improved compatibility to contemporary operating systems.
This engine reimplementation requires a legitimate copy of original game assets to run and supports loading retail CD rips or digital editions directly without manual file extraction.

items.value: Widescreen and high-definition rendering support up to 1080p alongside the classic 640x480 video mode
Direct asset playback from raw disc images including ISO, BIN, and CUE pairs
Full controller support featuring customizable mapping, radial deadzones, and D-pad rebinds
Optional orbitable third-person exterior follow camera controllable with mouse or analog stick
Fixed 60 Hz simulation step ensuring consistent movement physics and jump distances
Full compatibility with original 1997 retail game save files
